seo.title: Saucin RP - Your City. Your Story
seo.description: Saucin RP is a custom FiveM roleplay server featuring optimized performance, custom scripts, whitelisted jobs, gangs, events, and an active staff team. Build your story as law enforcement, EMS, criminal, or civilian in a dynamic, community-driven GTA V RP experience.

server.name: Saucin RP
server.slogan: Where grinders, creatives, and criminals collide.
server.description: Saucin RP is a custom FiveM roleplay server built for story-driven, serious and semi-serious roleplay. Dive into a fully customized city with unique scripts, whitelisted careers, gangs, events, and an active staff team that actually cares. Whether you’re law enforcement, EMS, criminal, or civilian, your choices shape the streets and your story in Saucin RP.

Build your legacy, one choice at a time

features.title: QBOX Core & Custom Scripts

features.title: Crews, Gangs & Turf

list.name: Los Santos Police Department
list.description: Primary law enforcement agency for downtown Los Santos, city neighborhoods, and dense urban areas. LSPD handles most local 911 calls within city limits, focusing on patrol, emergency response, traffic enforcement, and community safety.

list.name: Blaine County Sheriff's Office
list.description: Primary law enforcement agency for Sandy Shores, Grapeseed, Paleto Bay, northern highways, rural roads, and county areas. BCSO handles county and rural calls, providing patrol coverage, emergency response, and law enforcement support across Blaine County.

list.name: San Andreas State Police
list.description: Statewide law enforcement agency focused on specialty response, gang investigations, warrant operations, proactive criminal enforcement, and major assistance anywhere in San Andreas. SAST supports local agencies while handling high-priority and statewide enforcement operations.

list.name: Department of Justice
list.description: Handle legal cases, court proceedings, taxes, and investigations as part of the justice system.

list.name: Paramedic
list.description: Provide advanced medical care, stabilize patients on scene, and transport them safely to hospital. Integrated with SAFR.
requirements: Basic medical training (in-city or prior RP experience)

list.name: Fire Rescue
list.description: Respond to structure fires, vehicle accidents, rescues, and support EMS on high-risk scenes.
requirements: Fire & medical training (in-city or prior RP experience)

list.name: Department of Transportation
list.description: Keep the roads clear and the city moving by handling tows, recoveries, scene support, and roadside safety.

list.name: Bail Enforcement

list.name: LS Customs

list.name: Trucker

rules.title: Active Development & Compensation
rules.description: Saucin RP is an active development project. Compensation is only issued when losses can be verified and is not guaranteed for crashes or dev issues.

rules.title: Common Sense (IRL Logic)
rules.description: If it would not realistically happen in real life, do not do it in roleplay. Keep actions believable, fair, and grounded in real-world logic.

rules.title: Stay In Character
rules.description: Stay in character during all active scenes. Do not use OOC communication in active roleplay. If your character cannot speak, use /me to roleplay actions or condition.

rules.title: Value Life
rules.description: Value your character’s life at all times. No fearless, suicidal, or unrealistic plays. Characters should act like their life and safety matter.

rules.title: No Random Violence
rules.description: All shootings, fights, or violent actions must have a valid roleplay reason, proper interaction, and clear build-up. Random or low-effort violence is not allowed.

rules.title: No Cheating / Meta
rules.description: No cheating, exploiting, abusing mechanics, stream sniping, or using outside information your character would not know. Discord callouts, external comms, or meta information are not allowed.

rules.title: Gangs = Structured Only
rules.description: Gang RP must be structured and story-driven. No random wars, cheap shots, or unapproved conflict. Gang wars and major conflicts must be agreed on by leadership and follow the server’s gang system.

rules.title: Cops = Realistic Force
rules.description: Law enforcement must use realistic force. Officers may use lethal force when there is a clear lethal threat, such as firearms, hostages, or immediate danger to life. Otherwise, situations should use proper escalation.

rules.title: Don’t Be Toxic
rules.description: Do not harass, bully, troll, discriminate, act racist, or bring weird or toxic behavior into the community. Respect players, staff, and the roleplay environment.
